title: Swoop - Taxi Booking App (rider + driver)
use_case: Native iOS phone UI for a two-sided on-demand service app, captured as real screens: onboarding (isometric 3D illustration on a lime top half, black bottom sheet with title, dots and round arrow), map home (hamburger, avatar, 'Where we go?' search, three round-icon quick tiles), route + option cards (lifted accent card with illustration, name, ETA, price; Apple Pay row; full-width CTA + round secondary), 'Looking for a driver' sheet (spinner illustration, from/to rows, Cancel), Arriving card (avatar, star rating, chat/call buttons, vehicle + plate), Add payment card sheet, You-arrived rating + tip chips + Submit, side menu (avatar, Trips, Payments, Favourites, Settings, T&C, Privacy, Support, About, Share), Trips history (date, from/to rows, price, COMPLETED tag), and a full component sheet (search/input states, main/secondary buttons, pill tabs, checkboxes, toggles, radios, tags, map markers). Best template for any request-and-match mobile app: rides, deliveries, home services, bookings, marketplaces that pair a requester with a provider.
source: Upwork portfolio - Swoop taxi app, rider + driver
